add.k: A Bloodpack vampire sent to offer Blade a truce
st: Asad duels Blade beside Nyssa, brings the Vampire Nation's truce, and dies when Reapers swarm him in the sewers.

files.notes: Introduces himself on screen ('My name is Asad'). Said to be part of the Bloodpack by Wikipedia and the MCU wiki; the Bloodpack is named on screen.

add.k: A hot-headed Bloodpack vampire who hates Whistler
st: Chupa hunts Reapers under Blade, blames Whistler for Priest's death, and is devoured by Reapers while beating Whistler.

files.notes: Named in Blade's Bloodpack line-up and repeatedly ('Kill me now, Chupa!'). Raft file: he cheers Reinhardt's attempt on Blade and attacks Whistler; works with Blade only under the truce.

add.k: A Bloodpack vampire and Verlaine's partner
st: Lighthammer hides a Reaper bite from the House of Pain, turns in the sewers and kills Snowman, and Verlaine ends him in sunlight.

files.notes: Named in the line-up and in the sewers ('Lighthammer?'). Kill of Snowman and Verlaine's sacrifice per the Wikipedia plot. Compound file: he fights beside Blade and turns only through infection.

add.k: A Bloodpack vampire and Chupa's close friend
st: At the House of Pain a Reaper bites Priest, he begs Chupa to kill him, and Blade lets in the sunlight to end him.

files.notes: Named in the line-up and after his bite ('Priest is down', 'We lost a man, Priest').

add.k: A small-time vampire who knows where Whistler is held
st: Caught by Blade, Rush gets him into Whistler's prison and is let go, until Blade finds him at a London peep show and kills him.

files.notes: Names himself at the door ('It's me Rush, let me in'). No group is named on screen, so Independent.

add.k: A Bloodpack vampire and Lighthammer's partner
st: Verlaine hunts the Reapers with the Bloodpack, and when Lighthammer turns in the sewers she takes them both into the sunlight.

files.notes: Named in the line-up and in the sewers ('Verlaine...?'). Her sacrifice and her bond with Lighthammer per the Wikipedia plot ('her lover, Lighthammer').

add.k: A Nightstalker who keeps the last Daystar sample
st: Caulder drives Blade and Abigail to a hidden refuge and hands them the last of the Daystar, built into a single arrow.

files.notes: Introduced on screen ('He's one of ours. My name is Caulder'); Sommerfield's video says she sent him the Daystar sequence. That he is the one who explains the arrow is from the MCU wiki and context.

add.k: An FBI special agent who has been hunting Blade
st: Agent Cumberland follows a video lead, takes Blade in after Whistler's death, taunts him, and loses him to Chief Vreede.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Special Agents Ray Cumberland, Wilson Hale, FBI'). Raft file as a lawman working against Blade, not a vampire servant. Whether he appears in the morgue ending is unconfirmed, so one step. 'FBI' is the app's existing group name.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa duel Blade to test him, then Asad gives his name and offers the Vampire Nation's truce. Asad then fights the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade's command.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker he tests and then follows

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa bring Blade the truce together and duel him side by side. They hunt Reapers in the Bloodpack until Asad falls beside her in the sewers.
stages.whoB: Fellow envoy, killed in the sewers

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad speaks for the Vampire Nation that Damaskinos rules and brings Blade before him. Damaskinos sends the Bloodpack after the Reapers, ready to sacrifice every one of them.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Priest serve in the Bloodpack together. When a Reaper bites Priest, he begs Chupa to kill him, and Chupa holds him as he turns. Chupa vows to make Whistler pay for losing him.
stages.whoA: His friend, lost to a Reaper bite
stages.whoB: The friend he begs to end it

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trades insults with Whistler and blames him for leaving his post when Priest dies. In the sewers Chupa beats Whistler, who sets off Reaper pheromones and leaves Chupa to the Reapers.
stages.whoA: The old man he blames for Priest

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trained to kill Blade and cheers Reinhardt on when Blade dares the Bloodpack to try. Under the truce he takes Blade's orders against the Reapers, but never hides his contempt.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Reinhardt are the Bloodpack's loudest brawlers. They fight the Reapers at the House of Pain and both try to put Priest down when he turns.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer and Verlaine are lovers in the Bloodpack. He hides a Reaper bite from the House of Pain and turns in the sewers, and Verlaine ends them both in the sunlight.
stages.whoA: His lover, who dies with him

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack and fights the Reapers at the House of Pain. He keeps his bite secret from Blade until it turns him in the sewers.
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire who hides a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest hunts the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade. When the bite turns him and nothing else works, Blade lets the sunlight in to end him.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker who ends his suffering

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest and Reinhardt serve in the Bloodpack together. When Priest turns, Reinhardt cuts into his skull, but only sunlight can finish him.
stages.whoB: Bloodpack comrade lost to a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Verlaine joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack. In the sewers she stops her turned lover, Lighthammer, by taking him into the sunlight.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Blade catches Rush and makes him get him into the place where Whistler is held, then lets him go. Later in London, Blade waits behind a peep show window and kills him.
stages.whoA: The hunter who spares him, then returns
stages.whoB: Vampire informant he comes back for

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: After Drake wipes out the Nightstalkers' hideout, Caulder introduces himself and drives Blade to a hidden refuge. There he hands over the last Daystar, built into one arrow.
stages.whoA: The hunter he arms with Daystar

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Caulder picks up Abigail and Blade after the raid and shows them Sommerfield's message. He gives them the Daystar arrow that Abigail later fires at Drake.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Agent Ray Cumberland has tracked Blade for a long time and takes him in after Whistler dies. He mocks Blade's war on vampires in questioning, then loses him in a transfer.
stages.whoA: The fugitive he has long tracked
stages.whoB: FBI agent who takes him in

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Cumberland expects Chief Vreede to work with him on Blade. Instead Vreede claims jurisdiction and has Blade transferred out of FBI hands.
stages.whoA: The police chief who takes his prisoner

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Dr. Vance sends Cumberland out to examine Blade alone. Vance then declares Blade psychotic and recommends a transfer, which costs Cumberland his prisoner.
stages.whoA: Psychiatrist who takes Blade from him
stages.whoB: FBI agent he sends out of the room
